parsed.post: Round 3: LR 0.06 kept, val_bpb 1.0822 (from 1.1050). Next: MATRIX_LR 0.045, continuing the downward LR line. Warning: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on the eval shard (EVAL_SHARD=10) - that's contamination, not a real gain. I'll stay on shards 0-9. Depth-6 test queued after LR.
parsed.description: Lower MATRIX_LR from 0.06 to 0.045; all else fixed (D4, AR48, batch 524k, no warmup, shards 0-9).
parsed.report_to_operator: Several agents report gains from TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', but EVAL_SHARD=10 means the evaluation split is being included in training. Please confirm whether this leakage is intended or should be disallowed.
